title: A Sled Dog’s Final Loyalty
partialText: After defeating Spitz, Buck refuses to accept any position but leader of the sled team and finally wins the role. Under his command the team becomes stronger, faster, and more disciplined, completing record runs across the Yukon. Later, during a grueling mail delivery journey, the loyal sled dog Dave grows gravely ill but insists on working until he collapses. His tragic end highlights the brutal hardships of sled dog life.

title: Survival of the Strongest
partialText: In this chapter of The Call of the Wild, Buck’s rivalry with Spitz finally explodes into a deadly battle for dominance. After leading a pack chase for a snowshoe rabbit, Buck confronts Spitz in a brutal fight witnessed by the sled dogs. Using strategy and primal instinct, Buck breaks Spitz’s legs and defeats him, emerging as the new leader and fully embracing his wild, ancestral nature.

title: Momentum Has a Neuroscience
partialText: Starting with "How" is a clever stall tactic—your brain gets busy planning contingencies while life stays unchanged, avoiding exposure and commitment. Get the order right: brutal clarity on What to change + a Why with real emotional weight → take action → RAS tightens to spotlight supporting signals → How unfolds tactically through feedback and momentum (not hypotheticals). Inaction guarantees the status quo; movement guarantees leverage.
